create_ped_solver: create a PED solver instance with configurable learning rates, projection, and random initialization
compute_gradients_ped: compute exploitability gradients for a Nash distribution estimate given payoff matrices
run_mirror_descent_step: run entropic mirror descent update step on the distribution parameters using computed gradients
run_euc_descent_step: run projected gradient descent update step on the distribution parameters using Euclidean projection
calculate_exploitability: calculate unregularized exploitability of the current distribution estimate
